title: Exhaust Tube Cut Length: Step-by-Step Maths for J-Bends and U-Bends
excerpt: Work out exhaust tube cut length the easy way: arc and tangent formulas, plus three worked J-bend and U-bend examples with every step shown.

notes: All three worked examples (2.5in OD, 3.75in CLR) were computed and cross-checked in Python: Ex1 18in/12in legs to corner -> straights 14.25/8.25, arc 5.890, total 28.39 (1.61 shorter than 30), fillers 6.25/3.25 with 8in/5in J-bend legs; Ex2 6in offset with two 45s, 20in/12in to corners -> diagonal 8.485, tangent 1.553, arc 2.945, middle straight 5.379, total 40.16 vs 40.49, fillers 10.447/5.379/5.447, cut marks 3.927 heel and 1.963 throat; Ex3 180 U-bend with 6in legs -> spacing 7.5, width 10, gap 5, arc 11.781, fillers 8/24, total 55.78, apex marks 7.854/3.927. Fractions are to the nearest 1/16. Example scenarios (leg-to-corner distances, offset) are invented layout numbers for teaching, not measurements of any car.
